question: How do I troubleshoot KOTOR widescreen resolution issues on PC?
answer:
Widescreen fixes usually start with a supported resolution and an aspect-aware HUD mod: verify your display mode in the launcher, then install a widescreen patch that adjusts menus and cutscene framing [1]. If the HUD or minimap is misaligned, check PCGamingWiki notes on supported resolutions and ini tweaks before chasing graphics-driver scaling [2].

Sources
[1] https://www.pcgamingwiki.com/wiki/Star_Wars:_Knights_of_the_Old_Republic
[2] https://deadlystream.com/topic/5849-widescreen-support/
